name: MD 500 / 530 (Hughes 500)
summary: Small, egg-shaped light turbine helicopter used by police, utility and film operators and by the Army's 160th SOAR as the MH-6/AH-6 Little Bird.

wings: Four-blade (early) or five-blade (500D/E, 530) main rotor on a short mast
Little Birds carry benches or weapon mounts on outriggers
engines: Single small turbine behind the cabin
Exhaust exits from the rear of the egg-shaped pod under the tail boom
fuselage: Rounded egg/teardrop-shaped cabin with a big curved windscreen
tail: Thin tail boom from the top of the pod
500D/E/530: T-tail with small endplate fins; early models: upper and lower fins with a small stabilizer
Two-blade tail rotor, or no tail rotor on the NOTAR 520N

tellTales: Tiny egg-shaped pod with a thin boom attached at its top
Five (or four) short blades on a stubby mast
Exhaust coming out the back of the pod beneath the boom

confusedWith.howToTell: The JetRanger has a longer teardrop cabin, a two-blade rotor and an exhaust stack on the roof; the MD 500 is a stubby egg with four or five blades.
The R22 has a two-blade rotor on a tall slender mast and a piston engine; the MD 500 has a short mast with four or five blades.

usCount.source: FAA registry make/model inquiry (Hughes/MD 369, 500, 530, 520N) + ~50 Army MH-6M/AH-6M (FlightGlobal World Air Forces 2025)
